blocks.text: DAVAO CITY—A coalition of political parties has been formed to secure a majority of the 80-member Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliament, just two weeks before its inaugural session. BARMM interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua told journalists here on Wednesday that the coalition had so far garnered 46 incoming members of parliament (MPs) into its fold. READ: BFP claims majority in BARMM Parliament with 46-seat coalition Macacua said the parties have signed a coalition document and that as of Wednesday, they are talking with some MPs about possibly joining their ranks.
